title: Meta Length Checker
h1: Meta Title and Description Length Checker
seoTitle: SEO Meta Length Checker — Title and Description Limits
description: Check if your page title and meta description are within recommended character limits for search results. Free and private.
intro: Paste a title and meta description to see character counts and whether they fit typical search-engine display lengths.
blurb: Check SEO title and meta description lengths against common limits.
howItWorks: Enter the title you plan to use in the <title> tag.
Press Check lengths to see character counts and guidance based on common display limits (about 50–60 for titles, 150–160 for descriptions).
examples: A 55-character title is usually safe; a 70-character one may be truncated.
A 155-character description often displays fully on desktop search results.
Use the tool before publishing a new page or blog post.

faq.a: Titles are often best under 60 characters. Meta descriptions under 160 characters tend to display without truncation on most devices.
